description:
Priority: P2 | Area: tooling | Labels: fix,area:tooling,P2 | Milestone: v0.1.0 | Task: CTX-0325

DEFECT (bitty-devtools campaign harness @ origin/main 7d51b8f): ProcessCtlDispatcher hardcodes the client env `BITTY_CTL_ELEVATE=1` (src/campaign.ts, dispatch()), but bitty's elevation allowlist parses comma-separated scope names (e.g. `terminal.manage,config.modify`; unknown tokens grant nothing). The live campaign therefore cannot exercise any elevated success path: probe `terminal:spawn-observable` (elevated:true) always fails Denied/ScopeDenied, and the denial probes pass for the wrong reason.

Repro: `bun campaign-live.ts` against a live bitty whose server allowlist includes terminal.manage still reports:
FAIL terminal:spawn-observable :: spawn failed: Denied/ScopeDenied
while a direct `bitty ctl terminal spawn` on the same instance succeeds.

Fix: drive elevation with the scope list (e.g. env { BITTY_CTL_ELEVATE: "terminal.manage,config.modify" }) and document that elevation is a server-side pre-grant, not a client flag.

Evidence: recording/ctx-0324/round2/logs/devtools-live-campaign.json, ctl/elevation-format.txt, ctl/elevated-verification.txt.
Do not fix under this task.
title: campaign: ProcessCtlDispatcher sets BITTY_CTL_ELEVATE=1, blocking elevated success probes
